Our guarantee

What we guarantee, in plain English

Every job gets a written workmanship guarantee from Oakwell Roofing Ltd. Here is exactly what that means.

Guarantee periods

WorkGuarantee
New roof (new slate or tile) 25 years
Flat roof (GRP or single-ply) 25 years
Re-roof using reclaimed slate or tile 15 years
Repairs 1 year

All guarantees cover our workmanship and are provided by Oakwell Roofing Ltd. They are not insurance-backed.

What it covers

Our guarantee covers our workmanship: the way the roof was built. If a slate slips because it was not fixed properly, if a flat roof lifts at a joint we made, if lead we fitted lets water in, we come back and put it right at no cost to you, for the full period of the guarantee.

What it doesn't cover

  • Storm damage, impact damage or damage caused by anyone else working on the roof after us. (That is what your buildings insurance is for, and we will help with the claim.)
  • Materials failing through a manufacturing fault. Those are covered by the manufacturer's own guarantee, which we pass on to you.
  • Parts of the roof we did not work on. If we repair one slope, the guarantee covers that slope.
  • Normal wear, moss and debris, or blocked gutters that have not been cleared.

Not insurance-backed, and why we say so

Some roofing firms sell insurance-backed guarantees, where a third party pays if the firm goes out of business. Ours is not insurance-backed. It is a promise from Oakwell Roofing Ltd, a limited company that has every intention of still being here in 25 years. We would rather tell you that plainly than let you assume otherwise.

How to make a claim

Call or email with your address and a photo of the problem. We come and look, and if it is our workmanship we fix it. Keep your invoice and the written guarantee we give you when the job finishes; they are all you need.

Want someone to look at your roof?

Call, send a photo on WhatsApp, or request a written quote. We come out, have a proper look, and put the price in writing.
